title: CBI Names Anil Kalya, Tunu Sahu In Fresh Chargesheet Over Reliance Communications' Rs 19,694 Crore Loan Diversion
description: CBI has filed a second chargesheet in the RCom case naming Netizen Engineering and directors Anil Kalya and Tunu Sahu for alleged diversion of Rs 19,694.33 crore bank funds, taking total chargesheets in Reliance ADA Group cases to four.
